Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 128. Category: technique. Rank 3.

Rank 3 melee technique
Ki Cost: 30 ki
Prerequisites: Meteor Strike, Lightning Jab
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: melee (20 foot cone)
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Strike out with a supercharged punch fast enough to
send a flaming shockwave through the air. If a target is
within melee range you may roll a Combo attack roll
dealing 2d10 bludgeoning damage + 2d6 fire damage
on a hit. Regardless of whether the you target
something with the strike you create a powerful
shockwave in a 20 foot cone starting from your square.
All creatures in the area of effect must make a strength
saving throw or be knocked prone and taking 2d10
bludgeoning damage + 2d6 fire damage on a fail. On a
success the target takes half damage and is not knocked
prone.
If you hit a target with the initial strike they
automatically fail the Strength Saving Throw.
